scene_context_seed.location_name: late Southern Briar Passage immediately before the Junction
scene_context_seed.runtime_note: HARD FIRST-SIGHTING RULE: do not clearly show the Briarhide Stalker before this boss trigger. Ordinary approach traversal shows Cyanis only. At the boss trigger the relevant cast may appear as simple field models; the Stalker itself is the required visual focus. Keep the pre-fight reveal concise and begin combat immediately afterward. The Stalker is a natural exceptionally strong Briarhide: no corruption, control, armor, device, special wound, purification, component-removal, or nonlethal solution. Combat party is Cyanis + Ilyra + Torren; Maevra never participates. No mandatory midbattle dialogue. After ordinary victory, use only a short portrait/dialogue exchange and return to Cyanis-only traversal. The Junction monument remains unrevealed until Beat 14. Cyanis carries the intact Card and it remains inert.

required_story_beats: Cyanis reaches the final route trigger before the Junction without having clearly seen the Stalker earlier.
The Briarhide Stalker is first clearly shown immediately before combat and blocks the usable route.
A very short character reaction may occur.
Boss combat begins with Cyanis, Ilyra, and Torren only.
The Stalker is defeated through normal combat victory.
The route to the Junction opens and the story shifts into quieter discovery.
